name: zclass_list_iterate_bucket_filtered
description: zClass_List::IterateBucketFiltered seeds global filtered iteration state on a non-null filter and returns successive matching nodes on null calls.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this shared iterator; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f690 validates storing the filter text, seeding g_zClass_FilterIterCursor from zClass_TypeList::GetBucketHead, returning null on the seed call, then advancing through links and returning the first node accepted by the supplied predicate.
The native smoke verifies seed-call/null-call iteration for exact-name and prefix predicates, cursor advancement, skipped nonmatching links, and end-of-iteration null.
